shared_elements: horizontal band(s) of repeated small motifs
rows of dense, repeated schematic marks covering a surface
justification: Both surfaces carry dense horizontal registers of small repeated schematic marks running in bands across the field, which is the only real correspondence and is a very generic one. A depicts a wall with a mounted animal skull and horn cores set below painted rows of small hand-like/geometric marks, while B shows only abstract rectilinear panel-like glyph blocks with no figural or animal element, so the specific content differs entirely.
